notes:
Topline: LineFlow is building a VS Code-first copilot (extension) aimed at teams that need low-latency inline suggestions + optional on-prem for enterprise customers. CRM notes (shorthand):

- Background: Founded 2021, product-market fit with 120 orgs using freemium extension; now targeting enterprise deals for repo-scoped AI features.
- Primary ask: streaming completion with sub-50ms median token latency for inline suggestions; graceful fallback to top-k completions when stream stalls.
- Auth model: prefer OAuth app with user-scoped tokens + workspace shared key for org features. Concern: PAT leakage in settings sync. SE asked about Redwood token scoping and short-lived tokens + refresh flow.
- Rate limiting: need per-user and per-workspace rate limits; engineering wants spike protection + transparent 429 headers for extension to show UX messaging.
- Model/version pinning: must pin model per workspace and allow per-repo overrides. Requested API to list compatible model variants for a given token budget (e.g. quantized variants).
- Caching: plan to use prefix caching + local KV for repeated completions (cold start policy discussed). Redwood Optimize interest: automated batching suggestions and quantization guidance for common C/C++/TS workloads.
- Security: SOC2 + SSO/SAML + audit logs required. They asked about KMS integration for encryption-at-rest for customer keys.
- POC notes: SE to run 72hr POC on Redwood hosted API with 3 dev teams. Metrics to capture: per-token latency histogram, reconnect frequency, percent of streams that return partial-chunked responses, token cost per active dev.
- Quote from Head of Product: "Dev adoption hinges on inline suggestions that don't feel laggy — think sub-20ms if possible, but pragmatic for now is sub-50ms median."
- UX edge-cases: extension should surface clear messaging on rate limits, and retry/backoff must preserve partial suggestions (resume token semantics).
- Legal: need statement on logs retention + ability to disable telemetry for EU customers.
- Next steps (short): schedule infra POC (SE + Redwood infra), legal to exchange data residency doc, run stress test with simulated 500 concurrent devs using extension.

Attachments / refs: Drive pricing deck, security FAQ, Fireflies call ids in linked_fireflies. Jira tickets raised for stream replay artifact (ENG-4430) and rate limit policy (INF-7621).
persona_insights: Buyer: Head of Product (wants differentiation via low-latency streaming). Technical champion: Senior Eng (owns extension and LSP integration). Procurement: legal + infra (data residency). Decision drivers: latency, predictable unit economics, SSO and auditability.
integration_requirements: VS Code extension using LSP-friendly streaming (SSE preferred). Support for inline partial-suggestions, cancelation tokens, and resume tokens for reconnect. Workspace-level model pinning API and clear 429/Retry-After semantics. SDK knob for client-side multiplexing across tabs.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: quick proof with hosted API + stream instrumentation (2 weeks). Phase 2: hardened POC w/ retries/backoff + SAML test (4 weeks). Phase 3: Dedicated evaluation for EU customers (8-12 weeks).
sales_play: Target engineering-led PLG accounts converting to enterprise via predictable pricing and Dedicated for data residency. Offer pilot credits and a short-term performance SLA for streaming. Review escalation path: se_assigned + owner + eng support.
